storyCards.headline: De Do Do Do De Da Da Da: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Police's "De Do Do Do De Da Da Da" reached #10 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #10 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

De Do Do Do De Da Da Da was released in 1980.

"De Do Do Do De Da Da Da" by The Police.

Chart story — peaked at #10 on the Hot 100.
